title: 第11章：「滚」
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
与此同时。

    江彩霞家里。

    “妈，我要吃肉，我要吃肉，这味道太香了，我受不了了。”

    “吃吃吃，老娘还想吃肉呢，买肉不要钱，不要肉票？咱们家哪来的肉票？”

    “我不管，我不管，我就要吃肉。”

    小崽子梗着脖子吼道，“我们家都没肉吃，马超家里凭啥能吃上肉？”

    江彩霞闻言愣住了，转头看向自家男人，“老田，你说，他家哪来的肉，这肉该不会是王素琴买的吧。”

    “不然他家哪来的钱，还有肉票。”

    江彩霞使劲摇头，“不对不对，王素琴那女人的性子我清楚，心高气傲的很，她压根瞧不上我们这些乡下的泥腿子，她会给马家买肉，除非太阳打西边出来。”

    说这话的时候江彩霞满脸不屑。

    事实上，做了这么多年的邻居，她早就把王素琴自私自利的性格给摸的透透的，也就马建业这个棒槌，会拿王素琴当成宝。

    “爸，马超今天还吃了肉包子。”

    小崽子一脸怨毒，斩钉截铁道，“我在他身上闻着味了，绝对错不了。”

    话落。

    田国庆看了一眼儿子，眉头皱得更紧了，空气里飘着的酱香，以及油脂的香气是骗不了人的。

    “他说的是真的？”

    江彩霞板着脸，“儿子还能骗你不成？今天我跟儿子可是亲眼撞见的。”

    “不行了，这***马家，大晚上的吃肉，也不怕噎得慌。”

    说话间，江彩霞从椅子上站了起来。

    “你干啥去？”

    “我去瞧瞧怎么个事。”

    “站住，你这个时候跑过去，丢不丢人。”

    田国庆一脸铁青，江彩霞不要脸，他一个大男人还能像个泼妇一样。

    江彩霞脚步不停，“丢啥人？吃不起肉那才叫丢人。”

    “妈，你等等我，我也要跟你一块去。”

    “儿子，赶紧跟上。”

    “好嘞。”

    看着两人急匆匆的背影，田国庆只得无奈地叹了口气。

    ……

    另一边。

    “大哥，呜呜…… 你做的红烧肉太好吃了，比我以前吃过的所有东西加起来还要好吃。”

    “大锅锅，莉莉碗里的肉肉七完了，莉莉还想再七一块，就最后一块。”
content_en:
at the same time.

    Jiang Caixia's home.

    "Mom, I want to eat meat, I want to eat meat, this smells so good, I can't stand it."

    "Eat, eat, eat. I still want to eat meat. There is no money to buy meat, no meat stamps? Where do we get the meat stamps?"

    "I don't care, I don't care, I want to eat meat."

    The little kid scratched his neck and yelled, "Our family doesn't have meat to eat, so why can Ma Chao's family have meat?"

    Jiang Caixia was stunned when she heard this, and turned to look at her man, "Old Tian, tell me, where did he get the meat? Could it be that Wang Suqin bought this meat?"

    "Otherwise, where would his family get the money and meat tickets?"

    Jiang Caixia shook her head vigorously, "No, no, I know the temperament of that woman Wang Suqin. She is very arrogant. She doesn't look down on us country folk at all. She will buy meat for the Ma family unless the sun rises in the west."

    When Jiang Caixia said this, her face was filled with disdain.

    In fact, after being a neighbor for so many years, she had already become aware of Wang Suqin's selfish character. Ma Jianye, a stickler, would treat Wang Suqin as a treasure.

    "Dad, Ma Chao also ate meat buns today."

    The little boy had a look of resentment and said decisively, "I can smell it on him. I can't be wrong."

    The words fell.

    Tian Guoqing glanced at his son and frowned even more tightly. The aroma of sauce and grease floating in the air could not be deceived.

    "Is what he said true?"

    Jiang Caixia said with a straight face, "Can my son still lie to you? My son and I met with our own eyes today."

    "No, this *** Ma family can eat meat at night without fear of choking."

    While talking, Jiang Caixia stood up from the chair.

    "What are you doing?"

    "I'll go see what's going on."

    "Stop, why don't you run over now? It's embarrassing."

    Tian Guoqing's face was livid, Jiang Caixia was shameless, even though he was a grown man, he could still act like a shrew.

    Jiang Caixia kept walking, "What kind of shame is it? It's a shame if you can't afford meat."

    "Mom, wait for me, I want to go with you."

    "Son, hurry up and follow me."

    "Okay."

    Looking at the two people's hurried backs, Tian Guoqing could only sigh helplessly.

    …

    other side.

    "Brother, woo woo... the braised pork you made is so delicious, it's more delicious than everything I've ever eaten before."

    "Big pot, Lily's bowl is finished with seven pieces of meat. Lily wants another seven pieces, just the last piece."
